HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Over-shoulder aftermath: Kangrim standing in a Pasa fire-temple yard at night, unbroken water jar locked in one hand, chest heaving, face half-mad; fallen quarrel shapes in crushed black midground. LEFT sheet = mortal Kangrim face (wilder eyes); RIGHT = Persia / Pasa rite board for fire-temple arches, oil lamps — ignore board faces. ONE device: the jar as a pale round stamp in the dark. Violent without deciding. Hex #4a4a58 in lamp specular on wet clay. Many practical flames, tenebrism. No text. No watermark.
